Pluto Transit in Aquarius 2023-43 | Pluto is back in Aquarius after 248 years 🦋✨

6 min read|Feruary 19, 2023|SHEETU

We will bear witness to a marvelous shift in the astrological calendar on March 23, 2023, as Pluto moves into Aquarius for the first time since the late 1770s (248 years). Pluto will transit back and forth between Capricorn and Aquarius till 2024, until it goes direct in November 2024 in Aquarius where it will stay for the next 20 years. Coming out of Capricorn in which it wreaked havoc for the past 15 years, revealing many government and power-structure corruptions relating to economy, security, control, misguidance and abuse, Pluto will step into the realms of freedom, revolution, technology, community and oneness. It will indeed be a ride into the future of humanity, destroying old structures to create a true Aquarian Dream. Pluto will find a lot of freedom when in Aquarius (much like how Uranus loves its stay in Scorpio). We can expect to see a massive paradigm shift that slowly starts from 2023.

On a global level: Power now will slowly shift back to the hands of people rather than a select few. There may be outrage over the control and corruption through social media platforms & information media outlets. Exposure of misinformation and misdirection spread by technological groups. There may even be leaks or demands for disclosure of “classified information”. Group and community efforts toward solving many important societal issues. Humanitarian ideologies will become a collective focus as activism, environmentalism and conservational efforts take the center stage. Societal and cultural norms will see significant shifts. Individual rights and freedom may first see major compromises or even restrictions leading to mass revolutions to end any subversive dictatorial rule. Major breakthroughs in inventions, technology and science. There may be a rise in social media obsession which will soon reach a peak and transform into conscious ways of utilizing information & internet. Surveillance and information monopolization that have their roots in social media will face backlash or even take down from the general public. 

Much like everything related to Pluto, there will be extremes in the way issues arise, are exposed, and dealt with all at the same time. Causalities of revolution may be too high if the reasons are blurred by rage & impulsivity. There may be major events in the technological world that will arise questions regarding the dangers of A. I./V. R, personal information on digital platforms, digital economy, etc. There may be a push towards equality, but to the extreme where everyone wants inclusivity in the notion that “everyone who participates must get a certificate just because” which can become a complex solution to simple issues rather than the other way around. So, this transit can either clear the way for a better future or silently get us closer to a dystopian one. Pluto in the sign of community, shared information & resources, technology and revolution will bring about an era of liberation in self & collective expression, freedom of speech and new ways of accessing/distributing resources. Gender & economic equality, sexual & gender identity issues, right to information, etc. will meet with defiance before finding their resolutions.

Class systems based on economic and other discriminatory status may see a popularity decline. Global markets will go through major transformations, including digital & foreign currencies, stocks and taxes. Natural & energy resource management may face crises and later find consensual resolutions. Global efforts toward bringing a sense of oneness and encouragement of peace will lead to major leaps in collective evolution.On a personal level:You might become more and more aware of possible toxicity in your personal & social circles, be it family, friends, or acquaintances. There may be an urge to explore hobbies and interests that stimulate your intellect & mind. You might stumble upon studies and topics that seem to demand your attention and slowly overwhelm you until you are submerged in their research. Art, technology and science may take a much more integrated space in your life where you seem to discover and rediscover interesting & enlightening information. You might even find yourself delving into occult, conspiracy, mystery, sci-fi, or other such controversial topics.  Spirituality might become a significant part of your life. 

You might even develop kindred & soulful bonds with others. Those who share common interests and mindsets may become a significant part of your soul purpose. Healing with regards to issues relating to family, friends, trusted acquaintances, or social groups. You might feel the urge to join activism & movements related to community/global issues. You will feel the urge to remove anyone/anything that is toxic, holding you back from your goals, preventing you from attaining your highest potential, and you will have no mercy for deceitful/controlling connections/situations. There may be victorious resolutions to issues surrounding power struggles with authority figures (in tyrannical, controlling and overbearing situations). You might be able to break free from constricting traditional ideologies or even family dynamics in order to realize your true calling. You will be able to utilize this surge of transformational energy to manifest your dreams and aspirations.

You will see extremes in your capacity of emotional expression, so, with conscious effort and healing you can use this transit to recover from attachment/detachment issues by developing a stronger emotional intelligence. Hence, you will find yourself focusing more on healthy relationships of all kinds especially with yourself. So, this can also provide a good opportunity to change any underlying negative psychological patterns in mindsets and self-talk. You might also become more adventurous in terms of leaving your comfort zone, pursuing your passions, socializing and expressing your opinions. Although you might have to be careful with taking risks since it is easy to overestimate/underestimate the actual gravity of the situation.

You can expect to experience a transformation in your Self-confidence. If you are aiming to become famous or wealthy, or both, your authentic self-expression, individuality, resourcefulness and unique personality will be the key, since Pluto also rules karma, transformation, power, riches and influence. You might experience spiritual events with sudden insights and shifts. You can expect to make significant progress on your soul purpose through extreme ups & downs leading to personal transformation and hence reap karmic rewards on your journey.  This transit will be one of its kind, bringing a much-needed shift in consciousness, societal change and collective evolution. Through the chaos and ruins of everything that no longer serve us anymore, will rise a Phoenix of transformation & prosperity. Pluto in Aquarius transit will usher in a brand-new era moving into the Age of Aquarius.
